svg.title: AgentsCommander Open Graph card
svg.desc: 1200x630 social preview. Helmet mark on left, wordmark and tagline on right, atmospheric terminal-row hint along the bottom edge. All colors from the locked Noir palette in src/sidebar/styles/variables.css. Helmet PNG is embedded as base64 so the SVG renders identically anywhere (librsvg blocks external file refs).

text.tspan: Run teams of Claude Code, Codex & Gemini
on the subscriptions you already pay for.
